product.title: Oahu Small-Group Circle Island Tour with Turtle Snorkeling

description.text: A small-group minibus circles Oahu with snorkeling among Hawaiian green sea turtles on the North Shore. A local guide travels with a group of about 24 to 28 people or fewer. Stops include the Dole Plantation, a macadamia nut farm, the Halona Blowhole, Diamond Head, and Makapu'u Beach, plus Kualoa Point on Kaneohe Bay for a view of Mokoliʻi. Round-trip transportation from Waikiki hotels is included. The North Shore snorkel is with Hawaiian green sea turtles. Waikiki hotels are the pickup and return point for the minibus.
